== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Kiffex (Japanese)|Kiffex]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156625017/NjXX2YdLHUGHgBS620I5yg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 89673873.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b2342fc5195e368682905a2d1b860b37822b600069d6d6b4b60015ce8369369b</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
